Printed under the totals.
May quote the customer's "reference" verbatim, \ included.

tables.comment: An invoice. Amounts live on its line items.

VAT as a fraction, e.g. 0.2100.

queries.text:

FROM customers a, customers b
WHERE a.id = $1 AND b.id = $2

queries.text: UPDATE customers SET email = $1 WHERE id = $2

queries.text:

queries.name: CreateInvoice

queries.text: SELECT id, customer_id, number, status, currency, issued_on, due_on, notes, created_at, paid_at FROM invoices WHERE id = $1
queries.name: GetInvoice

queries.text: SELECT status FROM invoices WHERE id = $1
queries.name: GetInvoiceStatus

queries.text: SELECT due_on FROM invoices WHERE id = $1
queries.name: GetInvoiceDueDate

queries.text:
SELECT invoices.id, invoices.customer_id, invoices.number, invoices.status, invoices.currency, invoices.issued_on, invoices.due_on, invoices.notes, invoices.created_at, invoices.paid_at, customers.id, customers.name, customers.email, customers.tags, customers.preferred_method, customers.accepted_methods, customers.metadata, customers.created_at
FROM invoices JOIN customers ON customers.id = invoices.customer_id
WHERE invoices.id = $1
queries.name: GetInvoiceWithCustomer

queries.text: SELECT id, customer_id, number, status, currency, issued_on, due_on, notes, created_at, paid_at FROM invoices WHERE id = ANY($1::uuid[]) ORDER BY number
queries.name: ListInvoicesByIds

queries.text: SELECT id, customer_id, number, status, currency, issued_on, due_on, notes, created_at, paid_at FROM invoices WHERE status = ANY($1::invoice_status[]) ORDER BY number
queries.name: ListInvoicesByStatus

queries.text: SELECT id, customer_id, number, status, currency, issued_on, due_on, notes, created_at, paid_at FROM invoices WHERE issued_on >= $1 AND issued_on < $2 ORDER BY issued_on, number
queries.name: ListInvoicesIssuedBetween

queries.text: SELECT number FROM invoices WHERE customer_id = $1 ORDER BY number
queries.name: ListInvoiceNumbers
comments: invoice numbers of one customer – in order, as printed on a statement.

queries.text:
SELECT id, number, status, due_on FROM invoices
WHERE customer_id = $1
  AND ($2::invoice_status IS NULL OR status = $2)
  AND ($3::date IS NULL OR due_on < $3)
ORDER BY number
queries.name: SearchInvoices
comments: Filters are optional: a NULL filter matches every invoice.

queries.text:
SELECT
    invoices.id,
    invoices.number,
    count(line_items.id)::bigint AS line_count,
    coalesce(sum(round(line_items.quantity * line_items.unit_price, 2)), 0)::numeric(12, 2) AS subtotal,
    coalesce(sum(round(line_items.quantity * line_items.unit_price * line_items.vat_rate, 2)), 0)::numeric(12, 2) AS vat
FROM invoices LEFT JOIN line_items ON line_items.invoice_id = invoices.id
WHERE invoices.id = $1
GROUP BY invoices.id
queries.name: GetInvoiceTotals
comments: Totals are computed in SQL, so rounding matches the database exactly.
Every aggregate is cast, since sqlc only guesses the type of a function call,
and coalesced where it can be NULL, since sqlc reports every cast NOT NULL.

queries.text:
SELECT invoices.id, invoices.number, invoices.due_on, customers.name AS customer_name, customers.email
FROM invoices JOIN customers ON customers.id = invoices.customer_id
WHERE invoices.status = 'issued' AND invoices.due_on < $1
ORDER BY invoices.due_on, invoices.number
queries.name: ListOverdueInvoices

queries.text: SELECT status, count(*)::bigint AS count FROM invoices GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
queries.name: CountInvoicesByStatus

queries.text: SELECT count(*)::bigint FROM invoices WHERE customer_id = $1
queries.name: CountInvoices

queries.text: UPDATE invoices SET status = 'issued', issued_on = $1 WHERE id = $2 AND status = 'draft'
queries.name: IssueInvoice

queries.text: UPDATE invoices SET status = 'paid', paid_at = $1 WHERE id = $2

queries.text: UPDATE invoices SET status = 'void' WHERE id = $1 AND status <> 'paid'
queries.name: VoidInvoice

queries.text: DELETE FROM invoices WHERE status = 'draft' AND created_at < $1
queries.name: DeleteDraftInvoices
